rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Wangyuyu, the tiny silver-white scaleless half-bodied fish of King Wu's leftover-fish legend.
ANATOMY: exactly one small living fish only four or five cun long and no thicker than a chopstick, pure silver-white and scaleless, only two black dots for eyes; the WHOLE slender body, from small head to tail, is one longitudinal HALF of a chopstick-thin white fish, with one clean flat missing-half side; the short ordinary fish face has NO BILL OR PROJECTING SNOUT, and flat plane belongs only to the body flank; no open wound, blood, bones, teeth or monster additions [wd-q10417993-c01, wd-q10417993-c07, wd-q10417993-c10]
MOMENT: bend sharply in a predatory-looking S curve close to the lens, seen in three-quarter SIDE VIEW so its thin half-fish body and full-length flat flank are unmistakable; two black dot eyes on the small ordinary head look toward the viewer.
POWER: no documented power; uncanny feeling through sourced half-body shape and reflection story only, a tiny natural wake from motion [wd-q10417993-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle underwater EXTREME MACRO close-up; entire S-curved thin half-fish body fills eighty percent of the square, one normal leaf only at the distant edge proves its tiny real size. Show near FLANK as full-length narrow flat half-body plane, far side rounded. No giant flat mouth, bill or fin. No inflated real size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one narrow cold dusk light shaft filtered through dark pond surface, harsh rim light, deep black shadows and disturbed silt.
SURFACE: smooth pearly white scaleless fish body, matte black dot eyes, submerged dark mud and wet fallen leaf.
SETTING: pond water near its reflective surface, as in the draining-pond and mirror-image account [wd-q10417993-c05, wd-q10417993-c06]
MOOD: uncanny and imposing at intimate range, never cute, calm or decorative; menace through strange anatomy, no vicious additions.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. No giant fish, sharp teeth, horns, scales, glowing eyes or extra real fish. The half-body plane is smooth and bloodless.
